Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.base
Package hibernate.base.persistence.tools

Enum Class EntityLintRule

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EntityLintRule>
hibernate.base.persistence.tools.EntityLintRule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EntityLintRule>, Constable
public enum EntityLintRule extends Enum<EntityLintRule>
Enumerates standard JPA entity mapping, structural, and performance anti-pattern rules shared across Hibernate reference implementations.

Each rule defines a standardized rule identifier (e.g. "JPA001"), a default LintSeverity, and a descriptive diagnostic message. Factory helper methods create pre-populated LintDiagnostic instances targeting class or attribute levels.

Since:
1.2.0

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    EAGER_TO_MANY_ASSOCIATION
    Using FetchType.EAGER on to-many associations (@OneToMany, @ManyToMany) leads to N+1 queries and Cartesian product issues.
    EAGER_TO_ONE_ASSOCIATION
    Using FetchType.EAGER on to-one associations (@ManyToOne, @OneToOne) causes unnecessary joins or extra select statements.
    FINAL_ENTITY_CLASS
    JPA specification forbids entity classes and persistent methods/fields from being declared final (prevents lazy proxy generation).
    FINAL_PERSISTENT_METHOD
    Final persistent methods prevent Hibernate from generating runtime proxies for lazy-loaded associations.
    MISSING_MAPPED_BY
    Bidirectional associations should specify mappedBy on the inverse side to avoid redundant join tables or duplicate foreign key updates.
    MISSING_NO_ARG_CONSTRUCTOR
    JPA specification requires entity and embeddable classes to have a public or protected no-argument constructor.
    UNORDERED_MANY_TO_MANY_LIST
    Using java.util.List without @OrderColumn on @ManyToMany associations causes Hibernate to delete and re-insert all rows on modification.
